item.content:encoded:
The site hosting the pictures for the three images of the Cistern Chappell, opium den, and Black Vault went down semi-recently.

The photos were part of the Special Photographs taken by the New South Wales Police Department from the 1910s to the 1930s. I'm not acquainted enough with Aussie copyright law but I figure that the fact that they were taken long enough ago to be Public Domain by now, if they weren't already by virtue of being taken during official governmental work.
